cards.name: Mylo in the Wild

effects.lua_implementation: The Fusion procedure requires exact Mylo plus a set Fairy.

official_references.matched_structure: Elemental HERO Neos Knight is the exact-name-plus-filter material analogue.

effects.printed_clause: Cannot be Summoned while you control a monster.
effects.lua_implementation: The uncopyable single effects now combine the conditional Special Summon prohibition with EFFECT_CANNOT_FLIP_SUMMON, whose condition checks for another controlled monster.

official_references.card_name: The Last Warrior from Another Planet
official_references.matched_structure: The Last Warrior from Another Planet demonstrates explicit summon-type prohibitions.

effects.issue: Confirmed and corrected: a face-down copy previously remained Flip Summonable while another monster was controlled.

effects.printed_clause: Main Phase/no other monster Quick Effect: Tribute this card; change all monsters to face-down Defense Position until end of turn.
effects.lua_implementation: The handler is released, all face-up turn-settable monsters are changed face-down, and the operated group is saved for End Phase.

official_references.matched_structure: Book of Eclipse turns all face-up monsters face-down and later changes surviving monsters face-up during End Phase.

effects.printed_clause: At end of turn, end the temporary face-down change.
effects.lua_implementation: Before turning the legal face-up monsters face-down, the operation separates their original Attack- and Defense-Position groups. At the End Phase it restores each surviving affected monster to its corresponding original face-up position.

official_references.matched_structure: Book of Eclipse officially flips affected monsters face-up Defense Position, but its printed effect explicitly says that; Mylo instead says the face-down state lasts until end of turn.

effects.issue: Confirmed and corrected: the prior End Phase operation returned every surviving monster in face-up Defense Position and lost original Attack Position.

effects.printed_clause: The quick effect is once per turn.

official_references.matched_structure: Ash Blossom & Joyous Spring supplies named HOPT structure.

effects.printed_clause: If sent to GY: return this to Extra Deck; also add Mylo from Deck, then send it to GY.
effects.lua_implementation: A forced delayed trigger independently returns this Fusion, searches exact Mylo, and sends the same added card.

official_references.matched_structure: Thunder Dragon Fusion supplies return-to-Deck/Extra handling.

cards.audit_note: Confirmed and fixed both the missing Flip Summon prohibition and original-position restoration.
